scope: Proposition 7.6 (The compatible towers) of the manuscript “Finite Smith–Toda Complexes at Varying Primes” (preprints/Finite-Smith-Toda-Complexes-at-Varying-Primes-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 308 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 13dce3978089a78f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 39. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist cycles b0, . . . , bn and their realizations Y0, . . . , Yn+1, together with the algebras La, LM a for 0 ≤ a ≤ n, satisfying Equation (7.1) and its sphere-to-M, initial-layer, tower-map, and ordinary δ-scalar compatibilities. Each bj has chain degree zero and weight wj. For each 0 ≤ a < n there are rational algebra maps Pa and fa as constructed above, and ga = fa(bu a) has chain degree zero and weight ia. It defines the next tower attachment and reduces modulo t to ba+1 under Equation (7.1).
